payload.description: Implement the missing control-plane integration for story plx-287b0f. A dashboard command must create one durable portable command with a typed envelope and stable Task identity; dispatch it through the selected Celery adapter; project authoritative progress, output, failure, cancellation, and terminal state into that same Task and its TaskStages; and tolerate idempotent replay. Preserve the existing Task UI contract. Do not use the legacy local dispatcher as the production bridge, add static cloud credentials, or introduce fallback routing.
payload.title: Connect dashboard tasks to the portable command lifecycle
